costs: Summable O(K^2/M) occupation tail plus thermal Gaussian tail; common core and finite covariance construction; no raw-Hamiltonian trace-class assertion.
baseline: Exact XY solvability and existing quasi-free CAR theory do not alone supply the uniform normalized whole-state crossover.
falsifier: Violation of residual tail, finite-column/core convergence, or a normal-state trace sequence not Cauchy within the stated compact family.
unresolved_gate: External proof validation, useful explicit finite-L rate and priority UNKNOWN.

falsifier: Gaussian MGF, tail or exact CPTP cutoff bound fails; rare non-Gaussian bursts explicitly show Gaussian hypothesis matters.
unresolved_gate: Optimal memory, thermal preparation, practical constants and external validation.
